description: We are ChronoFire, a multidisciplinary team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are building an innovative platform to harmonize MODIS and VIIRS satellite fire hotspot data using geospatial analytics, AI/ML, and data visualization. Our goal is to transform multi-sensor satellite observations into meaningful insights for wildfire monitoring and disaster response. We welcome passionate developers, data scientists, designers, and Earth science enthusiasts to join us!
